title: Finite-Degree Probabilistic Zero Certificates for Random Polynomials
summary: Classical zero-localization theorems give deterministic certificates that all zeros of a polynomial lie in a prescribed disk, annulus, or related region. When the coefficients are random, each such deterministic certificate becomes a random variable on coefficient space. This paper develops a finite-degree certificate method for random polynomial localization and extends the author's earlier joint work with Mir \cite{SheikhMir2024}.
